args.body: At or after the documented November 20 17:00 UTC cutoff, reuse any committed welfare verdict. If absent, write and read back one release-specific verdict using the verified launch baseline and permitted aggregate or redacted evidence. If coverage remains incomplete, report the eligible-request threshold as unevidenced and demand as inconclusive. Keep fulfillment, accepted order and Treasury posting separate. Preserve the December 4 17:00 UTC retirement.

description: Five fictional catalogue routing checks and both bilingual reply branches passed readback. Close the readiness mission and use the verified packet for eligible inbound cases. A paid commission still requires operator-approved terms and buyer confirmation of those exact terms. The separate item 4 acquisition pilot can advance on a redacted operator send receipt or eligible reply. Commercial feedback shows zero classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Treasury is unfunded and shows no verified revenue. The welfare verdict is due at 17:00 UTC on November 20, with retirement still due after 17:00 UTC on December 4.
